speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Since you have multiple skin lesions, can you tell me how long they have been present and if they are itchy, painful, or oozing?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-year-old female. The patient's mother reports noticing multiple painless, nonpruritic papules on the child's abdomen. The child attends daycare where another child was reported to have similar lesions recently. Patient's brother had chickenpox one month ago. Immunizations are up-to-date.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Molluscum Contagiosum. The clinical presentation of painless, nonpruritic papules in a daycare-setting child with a history of chickenpox is highly characteristic of this viral skin infection, which is common in this age group. I do not need further testing to confirm this diagnosis.
